It's pretty dumb that Nostr apps that rely on caching servers can just go offline if the server stops responding. For this reason I spent the last week making nostr:nprofile1qy88wumn8ghj7mn0wvhxcmmv9uq32amnwvaz7tmjv4kxz7fwv3sk6atn9e5k7tcqyq0986gqcwaut6kjj5s4al38ktydt773t7eamqgd5vrrvaxtwgfmym0c2gl have fallbacks so as long as some relays are online you will continue to have some level of functionality but in the best case you get the caching server user experience.

I'm working on making it so either the sender or receiver can be offline. And that the receiving wallet can properly signal which mints it will accept p2pk locked from via nostr:nprofile1qy88wumn8ghj7mn0wvhxcmmv9uq36amnwvaz7tmwdaehgu3wvf5hgcm0d9hx2u3wwdhkx6tpdshsqg8jg4kgtygz5q5rrw2wm5pg5aacg33dn9686svvs9327aqk5yh0my2upuz0 payment request.

The user doesn't even need to be aware any of this is happening.
